message.content: [from lander-lead] the laptop lander is slow

input.command: gh issue create -R tompassarelli/north --title 'Run the lander on gex45' --body-file /tmp/b.md

content.text: I recommend moving the lander to gex45 because it is idle and the laptop is at load 50; the alternative is to keep it local, which slows every landing by about a minute. Filed north#700 and launched its worker.
